decision_boundary: This model is an input to Architecture Freeze/Cost GO and is not topology approval.

official_rosa_service_pricing.region_behavior: ROSA service fees are uniform across supported AWS standard Regions
official_rosa_service_pricing.aws_infrastructure_price_behavior: Region-specific and must be refreshed for ap-northeast-2 at Cost GO

structural_cost_formula.classic_aws_infrastructure: worker_ec2 + worker_ebs + control_plane_ec2_ebs + infrastructure_node_ec2_ebs + required_network + other_project_attributable_aws_cost
structural_cost_formula.expected_cash_out: observed_net_when_available; otherwise separate UNKNOWN/ESTIMATED value, never used to expand gross ceiling

reference_only_minimum_worker_service_sc.purpose: Show only the ROSA service-fee difference before Seoul AWS infrastructure prices are populated.
reference_only_minimum_worker_service_sc.warning: Do not use these totals as project Cost-to-Complete. Classic has additional customer-account control-plane/infrastructure AWS costs; HCP has the cluster fee.

current_result.reason: Exact project sizing/runtime and Portability Gate remain incomplete. External billing detail is not required to build a conservative gross estimate.
